questions.question: In a pool of length 50 m and width 45 m, 90 persons take a dip, If the average displacement of water by the person is 1 m³, then how much will the water level rise?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

In a pool of length 50 m and width 45 m, 90 persons take a dip, If the average displacement of water by the person is 1 m3,

**Concept used:**

The volume of water displaced = Displacement of water by 90 men

**Calculation:**

Let, the rise in the water level be h

As per the question,

⇒ 50 × 45 × h = 90 × 100

⇒ h = (90 × 100)/(50 × 45)

⇒ h = 2 × 2

⇒ h = 4 cm

**∴ The water level rise by 4 cm**

questions.question: The average attendance at a football club fell by 11% in 2015 in comparison to the previous year. If 3190 fewer people went to see matches, how many went in 2014?
questions.solution:

Value of 11 % = 3190

So value of 100 % = (3190 / 11) × 100

⇒ 290 × 100 = **29000**

So value of 100 units = (3190 / 11) × 100

⇒ 290 × 100 = 29000

questions.question: If the difference between the compound interest and simple interest on Rs. 16,000 2 years at a certain rate of interest per annum is Rs. 102.40, then find the rate of interest per annum.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The difference between the compound interest and simple interest on Rs. 16,000. 2 years at a certain rate of interest per annum is Rs. 102.40

**Formula used:**

The difference between SI and CI for 2 years will be,

Difference = Principal × (R /100)² (R = rate of interest)

**Calculation:**

According to the question,

102.40 = 16000 × (R / 100)2 

⇒ R² = (102.40 × 100 × 100)​ \ 16000

⇒ ​R2 = 64

⇒ ​R = √64

⇒ R = 8%

**The rate of interest per annum will be 8%**

questions.question: P can do a piece of work in 30 days and Q can do the same work in 40 days. They worked together for 5 days and then Q left. How much time (in days and hours) will P, working alone, take to complete the remaining work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

P can do a piece of work in 30 days 

Q can do the same work in 40 days

They worked together for 5 days and then Q left

**Concept used:**

Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken)

Efficiency = work done in a single day 

**Calculation:**

Let total work is 120 units ( LCM of 30 and 40) 

The efficiency of P = 120/30

⇒ 4 units

The efficiency of Q = 120/40

⇒ 3 units

So P + Q together do in one day 4 + 3 = 7 units

So they do in 5 days 7 × 5 = 35 units

Remaining, 120 - 35 = 85 units done by P 

P does the work in 85 / 4 = 21(1)/(4) days

⇒ 21 days 6 hours

**∴ P take to complete the remaining work is 21 days 6 hours.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] __Additional Information__** (Efficiency of a Person is inversely proportional to the number of days to complete the work)

questions.question: A train running at a speed of 126 km/h crosses a pole in 6 seconds. The length of the train is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A train running at a speed of 126 km/h crosses a pole in 6 seconds.

**Concept used:**

Distance = speed × time 

**Calculation:**

126 km/h = 126 × 5/18

⇒ 5 × 7 = 35 m/s

So, in 6 seconds train covers his own length = 35 × 6

⇒ 210 m

**∴ The length of the train is 210 m.**

questions.question: Two varieties of wheat have been mixed. In 60 kg of wheat, 40% wheat is of A quality and 60% wheat is of B quality. How much wheat of A quality should be further added to the mixed wheat so that there is only 40% of B quality wheat?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Two varieties of wheat have been mixed. In 60 kg of wheat, 40% wheat is of A quality, and 60% of wheat is of B quality.

**Calculation:**

Amount of A quality wheat in 60 kg = 60 × 40 / 100

⇒ 24 kg

Amount of B quality wheat in 60 kg = 60 × 60 / 100

⇒ 36 kg

Let,we have to add x kg

According to the question,

(24 + x) / 36 = 60 /40

⇒ (24 + x) / 36 = 3 / 2

⇒ (24 + x) = 54

⇒ x = 54 - 24

⇒ x = 30 kg

**∴ 30 kg wheat of A quality should be further added to the mixed wheat. **

questions.question: A and B together can do a piece of work in 16 days. If A is 50% less efficient than B, then in how many days can A, working alone, complete the entire work?
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**A is 50% less efficient than B means, 

A is 1/2 less than B 

Efficiency of A = 1, and B = 2 then,

A and B completed total work in 16 days

Total work = Efficiency × Total time taken

Total work = (1 + 2) × 16 

⇒ 48

A can completed the total works in,

 ⇒ 48/1 = **48 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__****Given:****A and B together can do a piece of work in 16 days. If A is 50% less efficient than B.**

**Concept used:**

Efficiency = (Total work / Total time taken)

Efficiency = work done in a single day 

**Calculation:**

Let the efficiency of B is x,

So the efficiency of A will be (x - x/2) = x / 2 

As per the question,

Efficiency ratio of A : B = 1: 2

So day ratio will be 2:1

If A takes 2y days then B takes y days 

As per the question,

(1 / 2y) + (1 / y) = 1 / 16

⇒ 3 / 2y = 1 / 16

⇒ 1 /y = 1 / 24

⇒ y = 24

So A takes 2y days = 2 × 24 

⇒ 48 days

**∴ In 48days can A, working alone, complete the entire work.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

(Efficiency of a Person is inversely proportional to the number of days to complete the work)

questions.question: A profit of 19% is made on goods when a discount of 15% is given. What profit will be made when a discount of 25% is given?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A profit of 19% is made on goods when a discount of 15% is given

**Concept used:**

Profit is calculated on Cost Price.

And the discount is calculated on Market Price.

**Formula used:**

P = ( (100space +space profitspace Percentage)/(100)) × CP 

SP = CP + Profit

Market price - discount = Selling Price 

**Calculation:**

Let the Market price be 100 unit

Selling price = 100 - 100 × 15/100

⇒ 100 -15

⇒ Rs 85

So the cost price = 85 × 100 / 119

⇒ 500 / 7

In 2nd case , 

Selling price = 100 - 100 × 25/100

⇒ 100 -25

⇒ Rs 75

Profit = 75 - 500/7

⇒ 25 / 7

So profit percentage = (25/7)/(500/7) × 100

⇒ 100 /20 = 5%

**∴ 5% profit will be made.**

Speed = Distance / Time

questions.question: P sold an article to Q for Rs. 18000 by losing 20%. Q sells it to R at a price that would have given P a profit of 8%. The profit percentage earned by Q is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

P sold an article to Q for Rs. 18000 by losing 20%.

Q sells it to R at a price that would have given P a profit of 8%.

**Concept used:**

Cost price - loss = Selling price 

Selling Price (SP) = CP + (Profit /100) × CP

**Calculation:**

As per the question,

Cost price of P = 18000 × 100/80

⇒ Rs 22500

Cost price of R = 22500 × (108/100)

⇒ Rs 24300

Profit earned by Q = 24300 - 18000

⇒ 6300

Profit percentage = (6300 / 18000) × 100

⇒ 35%

**∴ The profit percentage earned by Q is 35%**

questions.question: The ratio of the income of A and B is x : y. When the income of A is increased by 20% and the income of B is decreased by 40%, then the ratio of the income of A and B becomes of A and B becomes 5 : 6. What is the value of {3x + 2y over 5x-y} ?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The ratio of the income of A and B is x: y. 

When the income of A is increased by 20% and the income of B is decreased by 40%, 

Then, the ratio of the income of A and B becomes 5: 6.

**Calculation:**

New income of A = x + x × (20 /100)

⇒ 6x / 5

New income of B = y - y × (40 /100)

⇒ 3y / 5

According to the question,

(6x / 5)/(3y / 5) = 5 / 6

⇒ 2x / y = 5 / 6

⇒ 12x = 5y

⇒ y = 12x / 5

Now, putting the value of y in (3x + 2y ) / (5x – y)

⇒ (3x + 2 × (12x)/(5) ) / (5x – (12x)/(5) )

⇒ (39x/5)/(13x/5) = 3

**∴ The value is 3.**

Selling Price (Sp) = Cp + ((Profit)/(100)) × Cp

Cp = ((100)/(100space+space profitspace Percent)) × Sp

Let the Cost price be 100

So, the selling price will be, 100 + 100 × 25/100

⇒ 100 + 25 = 125 

As per the question,

Value of 125 units = 625

⇒ Value of 100 units = (625 / 125) × 100

⇒ 5 × 100 = Rs 500

So if 35% gain the selling price will be 

500 × (135 /100)
